description: This file contains functions to create and serialize various types of USP (User Services Platform) records, including WebSocket, MQTT, STOMP, UDS connect, and disconnect records, using Protocol Buffers. It handles serialization, memory management, and prepares data for transmission.

methods.name: USPREC_WebSocketConnect_Create
methods.description: Creates and serializes a WebSocket connect record, preparing it for transmission.

methods.name: USPREC_MqttConnect_Create
methods.description: Creates and serializes an MQTT connect record with specified protocol version and topic.

methods.name: USPREC_StompConnect_Create
methods.description: Creates and serializes a STOMP connect record with specified destination.

methods.name: USPREC_UdsConnect_Create
methods.description: Creates and serializes a UDS connect record.

methods.name: USPREC_Disconnect_Create
methods.description: Creates and serializes a disconnect record with reason and code.
